course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Consider an M/G/1/GD/∞/∞ queuing system in which an average 10 arrivals occur (14) [CO4] each hour. Suppose that each customer's service time follows an Erlang distribution, . with rate parameter 1 customer per minute and shape parameter 4. Now,
(i) Find the expected number of customers waiting in line.
(ii) Find the expected time a customer will spend in the system.
(iii) What fraction of the time will the server be idle?
